verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a SaaS meeting-notes product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or residency. The documented privacy controls (configurable retention including zero-day retention, and Super Admin export/delete) are adjacent features and earn no credit toward region selection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
